journey.name: wear send own invoice guard
journey.description:
The watch refuses to pay an invoice it created itself (the self-send guard, docs/wear.md › Self-send guard): the invoice of its own Receive page, opened as a `lightning:` link on the same watch, ends on "Can't pay own invoice" before any hold. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet on the local ./spark stack with a balance above 0, see journeys/wear/README.md › Local ./spark stack, on the Balance page with the loading ring stopped. Gestures are written for the 454 px screen.

actions.action: Swipe the pager left once: `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`
Wait up to 10 s until `adb shell uiautomator dump` lists "WatchReceiveQr" (README, top)
Read the invoice from the log as in README › Reading the receive invoice and note it as <invoice>
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Wait up to 10 s until "WatchSendError" is listed
Verify Home is back on the Receive page it was left on: "WatchReceiveOpen" is listed
